title: Enhanced Mask2Former With Multi-Scale and High-Resolution for Concrete Bridge Crack Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Mask2Former plus a multi-scale RepBlock fusion module and a high-resolution wavelet-conv (WTConv + DEConv) branch with channel/spatial attention to keep fine cracks.
adaptation: In our M2F arm add a stride-1/2 conv branch from the raw EL image into the pixel decoder; same idea as doi:10.3390/electronics14142834 (local perception + aux conv, +3.2 mIoU pavement).
min_experiment: Part of M2F arm B (with dense aux head) vs arm A; metric crack relF1@2 and crack IoU; kill the branch if relF1@2 gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: bridge cracks mIoU 86.33, F1 85.07; each module alone 86.22 / 85.99 mIoU over baseline (baseline number not in abstract).
